We need to determine the appropriate crime label(s) based on the facts. The pattern: The examples show mapping from facts to a short label list, using Chinese legal terms.

The facts: illegal raising of public funds via internet, using “报单点” (investment scheme) promising high returns, recruiting people, paying referral fees. This is classic illegal fundraising / illegal public deposit, i.e., “非法吸收公众存款”. In examples, that label is used for similar cases: e.g., earlier example about 郑某甲 (mutual aid) gave “非法吸收公众存款”. Also the example about 郭某 (illegal fundraising) gave “非法吸收公众存款;妨害作证”. So the correct label is “非法吸收公众存款”. Possibly also “集资诈骗” or “非法集资” but the standard label used in dataset is “非法吸收公众存款”. The example about “集资诈骗” used for a large fraudulent fundraising with high interest loans, but that was described as “非法集资” (illegal fundraising) but they labeled as “集资诈骗”. However the description there: “以非法占有为目的，采用诈骗方法非法集资，数额特别巨大” and they labeled “集资诈骗”. In this case, they are also using high returns, but the description says “非法面向社会吸收公众存款”. That matches “非法吸收公众存款”. So answer: single crime.
